newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel detains policemen who beat Palestinians.
newsitem.headline: Israel detains policemen who beat Palestinians.

text.p: Israeli authorities on Tuesday detained two paramilitary border policemen caught on an amateur video beating Palestinians, a Justice Ministry spokeswoman said.
"They've been detained for 24 hours for questioning," she said. They were taken into custody by a Justice Ministry department in charge of investigating alleged police misdeeds.
Israel Radio said the two border policemen could face criminal charges.

Israel's police commissioner suspended the two after state-owned Channel One television broadcast a video showing the border policemen abusing several Palestinians who entered Jerusalem without Israeli work permits.
The video was recorded last month by an amateur Palestinian cameraman, the television said.
In the courtyard of an apartment complex, the two policemen kicked some of the Palestinians in the head, kneed another in the stomach and made others lie on the ground and do push-ups.
The report said the abuse went on for 45 minutes.

"I saw the video last night and I was shocked. I have never seen such an interaction between human beings...and I must say that for me it was a rare picture," said Internal Security Minister Avigdor Kahalani.
Palestinians say abuse by border police, who are deployed across the West Bank, is common.
Israel has given Palestinians limited self-rule in parts of the West Bank under Israel-PLO peace deals signed since 1993 but Israeli troops still patrol much of the area.
